summary: Vellacombe readout (January 2019) for programme VD-18-131 with the Rennelwick Institute Drug Discovery Unit: chemistry guided by X-ray co-crystal structures solved by the Institute's structural biology collaborators. A less hindered substituent was chosen from the co-crystal structures and material was delivered for binding studies. Structural biology work was done by the collaborator.

slides.title: Rennelwick receptor programme: co-crystal-guided analogues
slides.subtitle: VD-18-131 readout | Vellacombe Discovery Ltd | 24 January 2019

slides.title: Where we are
bullets: Programme started 05/11/2018 with the Rennelwick Institute Drug Discovery Unit
Institute's structural biology collaborators supplied two X-ray co-crystal structures in December
Chemistry plan revised against the structures
Delivery lot for binding studies completed this week

slides.title: What the co-crystal structures showed
bullets: Ligand sits deeper in the pocket than the docking model assumed
The bulky ortho substituent clashes with a backbone carbonyl

bullets.text: Explains the flat SAR seen in the first analogue set

bullets: Room for a smaller group pointing to solvent
slides.notes: Structures belong to the Institute; images not reproduced here. Ask Rennelwick before showing externally.

slides.title: Hypothesis
bullets: Replace the ortho substituent with a less hindered group
Keep the hinge-facing amide unchanged
Use the solvent vector for solubility

slides.title: Route
bullets: Common intermediate from route scout 1
Two-step coupling then amide formation
Route risk: regioisomer in step 1
bullets_right: Purity release by LCMS area percent

slides.title: Route gate (17/12/2018)
bullets: Regioisomer controlled below 2% by lower temperature
Gate passed; analogue preparation started

slides.title: Delivered
bullets: Delivery lot 1 for binding studies
Identity confirmed by 1H NMR and LCMS
All lots above the agreed purity threshold

slides.title: Proposed versus isolated
bullets: All proposed analogues of the first design round isolated
Two solvent-vector analogues proposed but not yet made
Isolated material only is reported as delivered

slides.title: Open questions for Rennelwick
bullets: Binding data on lot 1 before the next design round
A third co-crystal structure with the smaller substituent would confirm the pose
Solubility of the solvent-vector analogues

slides.title: Next analogue
bullets: Pending binding data: extend the solvent vector with polar groups
Hold the hinge amide
Next readout planned for March
